cases.d: Verify an invited member sees the open room and gets a join token.
exp: The room has status "Open" and myRole "Member".
Join returns HTTP 200 with the room name of the meeting, the member's id as identity and a LiveKit token.
pre: An InProgress Online meeting with the Member invited.

cases.d: Verify someone not invited gets the same empty 404 as for an unknown meeting.
steps: As an outsider, GET /api/meetings/<id>/call and POST /api/meetings/<id>/call/join.
exp: Both return HTTP 404 Not Found with an empty body.
pre: An InProgress Online meeting; the outsider is not on the roster.

cases.d: Verify anonymous callers cannot join a call.
Verify join refusals carry their own code.
steps: As the invited Member, join a Published (not started) Online meeting.
exp: Not started: HTTP 409 with code "MSG117" (the room opens only while the meeting is in progress).
In person: HTTP 409 with code "MSG280" (this meeting is held in person, so it has no online room).
pre: Both meetings have the Member invited.

cases.d: Verify joining returns 503 when LiveKit is not configured.
exp: HTTP 503 with code "MSG281" ("Phòng họp trực tuyến chưa sẵn sàng. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên.").
pre: An InProgress Online meeting with thanhvien invited.
LiveKit settings are removed from the backend configuration.

cases.d: Verify database failures have their own codes.
steps: As the Member, GET /call, POST /call/join and POST /call/participants/<id>/mute.
exp: Join returns HTTP 500 with code "MSG118" ("Không thể vào phòng họp. Vui lòng thử lại.").
Mute returns HTTP 500 with code "MSG284" ("Không thể tắt micro. Vui lòng thử lại.").
pre: Signed in as a member of an InProgress Online meeting.

cases.d: Verify only the Chair can mute, and only someone in the room with a microphone.
steps: As the Member, mute the Chair.
As the Chair, mute the Member before they join.
The Member joins with the microphone on; the Chair mutes them.
exp: Member muting: HTTP 403 with code "MSG123" (only the Chair can mute).
Not in the room: HTTP 409 with code "MSG282".
In the room: HTTP 200 and the Member's microphone is muted.
pre: An InProgress Online meeting with Chair and Member; LiveKit configured.

cases.d: Verify muting in a room that is not open returns MSG117.

req.url: /api/meetings/<id of the Ended meeting>/call/participants/<any user id>/mute
req.as: Authorization: Bearer <access token of the meeting Chair>

pre: An Ended Online meeting whose Chair is signed in.

cases.d: Verify a webhook with a bad signature is refused and a signed one is handled.
steps: POST /api/livekit/webhook with body {} and no valid signature.
POST a participant_joined event signed with the LiveKit API secret.
exp: Signed: HTTP 200 OK and the participant's join is recorded for the meeting.
pre: LiveKit is configured with an API key and secret.

cases.d: Verify the LiveKit webhook returns 503 when LiveKit is not configured.
pre: LiveKit settings are removed from the backend configuration.
